description.value: A frontcountry BC Parks campground managed by the Osoyoos Indian Band, sitting just off Hwy 97 on Green Lake Road at the edge of Okanagan Falls town and near the historic 'little falls' on the Okanagan River; easy highway access but gate-locked off-season and closed one weekend in late September for the Salmon Feast.

address.value: Green Lake Road, Okanagan Falls, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms an active frontcountry campground managed by the Osoyoos Indian Band, located on Green Lake Road approximately 500m from the Hwy 97 junction near Okanagan Falls. OSM tag drinking_water=yes supports potable water; the BC Parks park page prominently displays a 'Book camping' button and the frontcountry camping subpage confirms reservations are available at parks in this system. No cycling-specific amenities (hiker/biker sites, showers, e-bike charging, etc.) are mentioned in either the OSM tags or website content.
concerns: OSM phone (+1-250-498-6577) is the Osoyoos Indian Band parks operator line but is not explicitly confirmed in the website content retrieved; the BC Parks contact page lists only general BC Parks numbers and refers users to individual park pages for operator contact info.
OSM address field is empty; address derived from website description ('Green Lake Road, approximately 500 metres from the junction of Hwy. 97 and Green Lake Road, Okanagan Falls').
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-documented frontcountry campground off Hwy 97 near Okanagan Falls — a logical overnight stop for touring cyclists on the South Okanagan corridor with confirmed water and reservations.

wow_evidence: managed by the Osoyoos Indian Band... near the historic 'little falls' on the Okanagan River
